title: Block Brains
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about blocks that take turns. Gates stand in a row, and each one is open for only a short while. A ring of blocks, each turning into the next after a few ticks, decides whose turn it is, and a row of lamps shows it: the lit lamp is the open gate. Mara watches, then walks through each gate in its turn. In the second level a sun ring and a moon ring run one step apart, so every sun gate opens together and the moon gates open as they shut. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how long a turn lasts.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie meets gates that open one after another. Rings of blocks keep the turns, and lamps show whose it is. Watch the lit lamp, then walk through each gate in its turn. A block cannot see you: it only follows its own timer. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how long a turn lasts.
features: Rings of blocks that turn into one another on a timer
Lamps and gates that take turns together
Made to be copied and taken apart
